title: host suites compiling vendored monocypher need -Wno-error=conversion for gcc-14 builds
description: Companion to v1bd (which fixed coap_slot_claim + schnorr48). Other host CMake suites that compile lichen/subsys/lichen/crypto/monocypher*.c directly will trip the same -Werror=conversion under gcc-14 (e.g. monocypher.c:1740) unless they add the per-source set_source_files_properties -Wno-error=conversion exclusion (mirroring the Zephyr build's project-wide flag). Sweep lichen/tests/*/CMakeLists.txt for monocypher sources and apply the two-line exclusion where missing.
